repairs: Leased journal descriptors use RAII through construction, rotation and append failures.
Write and fsync failures durably roll back the partial record and preserve the original diagnostic; unrecoverable service appends disable decisions.
Replay parses one bounded record at a time and validates enum/length fields only after its checksum.
Open questions close only on the exact epoch/revision derivation; a newer same-id ask supersedes the prior ask.
The headless observer changed hook journals asks and source closures without requiring an attached GUI client.
Locally invalid decisions are rejected before a durable approval record; a valid but undelivered decision receives an exact compensating closure.
A null journal, failed recovery, failed decision append, or failed compensation refuses delivery and requests a retry.
Rotation is attempted only before a future append, so a rotation failure cannot turn an already durable decision into a caller-visible append failure.
A user decision is durable intent; a separate delivered record closes it only after adapter acceptance.
A failed delivery confirmation or compensation leaves the ask open for restart outcome_unknown classification.
Directory fsync failures and journal format zero are fail-closed rather than ignored.
A real SessionService service-level test holds the journal lease and proves the production decision path refuses forwarding while retaining the pending request and retry diagnostic.
Transport-uncertain Codex delivery leaves durable intent open for outcome_unknown recovery instead of recording a final refusal closure.
A failed append with a still-usable descriptor remains retryable; only descriptor loss permanently disables the journal.
A first-sequence user decision with no preceding ask remains open for unknown-outcome recovery.
Replay caps include the string request ID, choice, five request strings, and every choice.
non_claims: No live Codex or Claude restart was exercised through the production SessionService process.
No native decision delivery through a real agent binary was exercised.
The full session-service clang-tidy scan retains three known pre-existing findings in unchanged permission/argument parsing.
The worker sandbox supervisor/quality failures remain environment observations; parent-host attention tests and repository quality passed at the final dirty tree.
